## Change

Describe the papers, metadata or reading experience changed.

## Evidence

Link primary sources and explain what each supports. Note version relationships and unresolved fields.

## Validation

Report relevant checks (`npm run build`, `npm run check`). Include generated Markdown and `docs/` when source data or application code changes.

Maintainer checklist: update `CHANGELOG.md` for the batch and follow the [maintainer workflow](../maintenance/README.md).
